identity_policy: Reuse this item for later updates; never create another item merely because a new local candidate is prepared.
verification_scope: Native success plus exact text, metadata tree hash, content-byte total, tags and preview presence; not a remote per-file SHA download.
preparation_record_policy: This file is the current item identity and upload/visibility status. Immutable release manifests describe their freeze-time state; uploaded=false in a historical preparation record is not the current Steam item status.

previous_verified_state.verification_scope: Native uploaded title, description, metadata, content bytes, tags, preview, dependencies and visibility2 read back. Gameplay acceptance unchanged.

current_visibility_source: Native successful update and verification; preserved pre-existing visibility0
candidate_update_status: native submit success and matching readback
